{{Quote|Entry 78: By Lord Vader's orders, we are abandoning all non-viable subjects. We will have to release 1157 into the training facility to see if the imprint finally holds...I can only hope, that in these final minutes, my life's work is not in vain.|The cloning technician during the Battle of Kamino|<ref name="TFU2 website" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''cloning technician''' worked in the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. The cloning technician monitored clones like [[Subject 1157]], a copy of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Galen Marek]]. Subject 1157 initially displayed great progress, and the technician was pleased to contribute to scientific progresses. The technician gave [[Memory flash|memory imprints]] to the clone. Over time though, Subject 1157's behavior became uncontrollable, and the technician feared that the clone would end in [[Aberrant clone|aberration]]. Later, during the [[Assault on Kamino]] of that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Subject 1157 was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-wielding]] individual [[Subject 1138]].

==Biography==
[[File:Tfu_subject_1157.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The cloning technician kept observation logs while Subject 1157 developed consciousness.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cloning technician worked in the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility in [[Timira City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="TFU2 website" /> around [[1 BBY/Legends|1]] [[Standard year/Legends|year BBY]].<ref name="TFU2 project">The website's perspective takes place before and during the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' project, which happens in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] according to the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''The Force Unleashed II'' comic]].</ref> The cloning technician monitored test subjects, including [[Subject 1157]], a clone of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Galen Marek]].<ref name="TFU2 website" />

The cloning technician recorded observation logs about Subject 1157 during the clone's various development phases. The technician recorded that 1157 had become conscious and was physically stable, and explained that the clone was experiencing tremblings. During his 25th entry about 1157, the technician reported that Darth Vader was coming as a result of the success of the project and mentioned his pleasure at the scientific progress the technician was making. The technician also monitored 1157 while the clone, like his template, developed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitivity]]. The technician gave the clone [[Memory flash|genetic memory imprints]] throughout his development. Subject 1157 was bothered by [[Force vision/Legends|"hallucinations"]] and required systematic restraints to control the resulting tremblings. The technician, as a result, instigated new desensitization techniques. By Entry 65, the technician hypothesized that the clone would end in [[Aberrant clone|aberration]] due to the clone's unstable behavior, and experimented with new sedation techniques. He was unsure how to proceed by that point.<ref name="TFU2 website" />

Later, Kamino was [[Assault on Kamino|attacked]], and the facility was subject to an evacuation order. In his 78th entry, the technician recorded that on Darth Vader's orders, they were abandoning the non-viable test subjects, and 1157 would be released out of his tank to see if the imprint held. The technician expressed a wish that his life's work was not in vain. Before Subject 1157 was released, though, an individual referred to as [[Subject 1138]] by the technician struck 1157's tank with a [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force push|Force push]], and the clone [[Death/Legends|expired]].<ref name="TFU2 website" />

==Personality and traits==
The cloning technician was proud of his work and believed he was furthering a cause by the development of test subjects like 1157. The cloning technician was well-versed in medical terminology and cloning, although at he one time, in response to Subject 1157's aberrations, was not sure how to proceed.<ref name="TFU2 website" />

==Behind the scenes==
Throughout summer [[2010]], the cloning technician was a character in the official website for the [[LucasArts]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]] before the site changed to an interactive database and removed the content he was in.<ref name="TFU2 website" /> The technician provided audio entries recording the development of [[Subject 1157]] for viewers to listen to. The content was also accessible through ''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' cloning tank website, and the last video is still active on that site.<ref name="Cloning Tank">{{LucasArts|url=games/theforceunleashed2/cloningtank/index.jsp|text=''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' cloning tank}}</ref>
